Hymn 29: A Poor Wayfaring Man of Grief
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major

This is hymn number 29 titled "A Poor Wayfaring Man of Grief" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Coles and the lyrics were written by James Montgomery.
